entities.name: Zayn
entities.description: A confident and sharp character associated with lightning power.
entities.quote: Zayn feels like the lead — confident, sharp, lightning incarnate.

entities.name: Samuel
entities.description: An anti-hero who is brutal and loyal to no banner, questioning ECAP and DEW.
entities.quote: Samuel (Ghost-01) is framed as an anti-hero: brutal, loyal to no banner, questioning ECAP and DEW.

entities.name: Ethan
entities.description: A character initially appearing calm and reliable who eventually dies.
entities.quote: The ending punch Ethan “dies.”

entities.name: Stitch
entities.description: A character who begins showing an obsession with control.
entities.quote: The cracks Stitch starts showing his control obsession.

entities.name: Nyxia
entities.description: A character who manifests power she does not understand, resulting in aether leaks.
entities.quote: Nyxia manifests power she doesn’t understand — aether leaks, not mastery.

entities.name: Alter Ethan
entities.description: A horrifying contradiction of the moral Ethan who emerges as a threat.
entities.quote: Alter Ethan appears mid-saga as a horrifying contradiction: “What if the most moral man becomes the worst threat?”

entities.name: Asetra
entities.description: A shadow figure revealed to be behind everything.
entities.quote: Asetra reveals herself as the true shadow behind everything.

entities.name: Elizah
entities.description: The gravitational center of Season 2, viewed as a necessary cruelty.
entities.quote: Elizah becomes the gravitational center. Not a hero. Not a villain. A necessary cruelty the world forced into existence.

entities.name: David
entities.description: Zayn's brother whose death is marked by loss.
entities.quote: David’s death: not heroic, not glorious — just loss.

entities.name: Agnus
entities.description: A guardian who broke natural law to protect his family.
entities.quote: Agnus (Altan El-Mansur): guardian who broke natural law to keep his family alive.

entities.name: Maliha
entities.description: Captured and corrupted by love and grief, later killed by Arzuna.
entities.quote: Arzuna kills Maliha, ending love corrupted by grief.

entities.name: Yoshiko
entities.description: Initially presented as a manager.
entities.quote: Yoshiko enters as “just a manager”... until she isn’t.

entities.name: Corvani
entities.description: A human who is tired, principled, and furious.
entities.quote: Corvani (Whale) returns — human, tired, principled, furious.

entities.name: Silas
entities.description: A legendary figure who dies at Arthur's hands.
entities.quote: Silas Duskmoor dies at Arthur’s hands. Sick, exhausted, but unyielding.

entities.name: Grace
entities.description: Awakened Athena’s Judgement and later retired from Vanguard.
entities.quote: Grace retires with Vanguard, mentally exhausted.

entities.name: Aariz
entities.description: Fought Elizah in a pursuit of strength.
entities.quote: Aariz fights Elizah, chasing strength — only to learn strength without restraint destroys you.

entities.name: Arzuna
entities.description: Shifted from a villain to an anti-hero.
entities.quote: Arzuna shifts from villain to anti-hero.

entities.name: Rowan
entities.description: Character unable to lift Silas's body.
entities.quote: Rowan cannot lift Silas’s body.

entities.name: Zaan
entities.description: Helps Rowan carry Silas's body.
entities.quote: Zaan helps him carry it, explaining grief is heavier than steel.

entities.name: Nilanjona
entities.description: Accepted guardianship before stepping away.
entities.quote: Nilanjona accepts guardianship and steps away.

entities.name: Eldrich
entities.description: A shadow guarding the throne.
entities.quote: Eldrich remains a shadow, still guarding the throne.

entities.name: Aeric
entities.description: Returned from a pocket dimension with forbidden knowledge.
entities.quote: Corvani & Aeric return from the pocket dimension with forbidden knowledge.

entities.name: Maverick
entities.description: A character mentioned in whispers.
entities.quote: Maverick is whispered — not shown.

entities.name: Niharo
entities.description: Villain who reorganizes in Season 4.
entities.quote: The villains reorganize: Niharo steps forward.

entities.name: ECAP
entities.description: Organization questioned by Samuel.
entities.quote: Samuel (Ghost-01) is framed as an anti-hero: brutal, loyal to no banner, questioning ECAP and DEW.

entities.name: DEW
entities.description: Organization conducting hidden experiments.
entities.quote: DEW experiments stay hidden, but the tone is wrong.

entities.name: Vanguard
entities.description: Group from which Grace retires.
entities.quote: Grace retires with Vanguard, mentally exhausted.

updates.new_facts: The organization was preventative, not evil.
updates.quote: The audience understands: Nullborn wasn’t evil — it was preventative.

timeline_events.title: The Death of Silas Duskmoor
timeline_events.description: Silas Duskmoor dies at the hands of Arthur.
timeline_events.quote: Silas Duskmoor dies at Arthur’s hands. Sick, exhausted, but unyielding.
